brandStory.para1: our journey began with a heartfelt inspiration — the divine purity, innocence, and blessing of Lord Krishna. Just as the flute symbolizes harmony, we believe food should bring peace, health, and joy to every household.
brandStory.para2: Based in Baligarh, Runnisaidpur (Sitamarhi, Bihar), we work directly with dedicated pond cultivators who dive into tranquil freshwater lakes to gather prickly water lily seeds. homeFaq.q1: What is makhana (fox nut) and how is it eaten?
homeFaq.a1: Makhana (Euryale ferox seeds) is a natural, gluten-free superfood harvested from wetland lotus ponds. It is traditionally roasted with a drop of desi ghee and rock salt for a healthy, crunchy snack. It is also used in Ayurvedic diets, vrat/fasting preparations, curries, and kheer dessert.
homeFaq.a2: 'Sut' is the time-tested traditional grading scale used by Bihar's makhana harvesters. '5+ Sut' represents jumbo, thoroughly puffed seeds (at least 1/2 inch across) with uniform crunch and minimal hard shell residue.
homeFaq.a3: Hriday Krishna Foods provides 5 sizes: 100g, 200g, 250g, 500g, and 1kg mega value saver. All packs come in moisture-proof airtight packaging.
homeFaq.q4: How is the product packed to retain freshness?
homeFaq.a4: Every batch is packed in an airtight, multi-layer food-grade resealable ziplock pouch that protects against moisture and oxidation, keeping the makhana completely crisp and fresh for up to 12 months.
homeFaq.q5: How long does delivery take across India?
homeFaq.a5: We dispatch orders within 24 hours of receiving them. Typical transit takes 2–4 business days for metro cities and 3–6 business days for the rest of India. Free delivery applies to orders ₹499 and above.
homeFaq.q6: Do you offer Cash on Delivery (COD)?
homeFaq.a6: Yes! Cash on Delivery is available for all eligible pincodes across India during checkout.
homeFaq.a7: If your shipment arrives damaged, unsealed, or defective, contact our customer helpline (+91 7654007494) within 7 days of delivery for an immediate free replacement or refund.
